caption:
The video captures a transparent glass sphere resting on a wet pebble shore in the left foreground, refracting an inverted image of the sunset. To the right, calm water meets a low distant shoreline beneath an orange-pink sky, the sun sitting just above the horizon and throwing a bright vertical reflection streak across the surface. The sphere holds its position, while the inverted scene within it shifts subtly in brightness.

Much of the visible motion is in the water. A thin sheet of wash moves over the foreground pebbles to the right of and behind the sphere, so the mirror-like wetted area grows and shrinks as the water laps and retreats. On the open water, the sun's reflection column changes shape, length and brightness, flickering as small ripples pass across the surface. The horizon line, distant land strip, sun position and sky color remain broadly stable. The scene reads as a quiet, ongoing shore wash rather than a single completed action.
